The main takeaway from our work is that
the equilibrium position in lipases-catalyzed esterification of fatty acids with butanol is dependent on the chain length of both reactants.

the equilibrium position in esterification catalysed by lipase can be predicted using the UNIFAC based model TREPEX, and that the equilibrium position can be modified by varying the fatty acid chain lengths and the presence of double bonds in the fatty acids.
